device.category: complete modular synthesizer, 16 Eurorack modules, MIDI-to-CV converter included
device.based_on: Moog System 15 (1973), recreated with Behringer 900-series modules.

sources.title: Behringer System 15 Quick Start Guide
sources.note: Module layout and example patches; module details deferred to each module's own guide.

architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic as patched (CM1A can run duophonic)
architecture.routing: fully patched: no internal connections between modules
architecture.summary: Behringer's recreation of a Moog System 15 in Eurorack modules: top row: 914, 923, 904B, 904A, 902, 902, 911, 911. bottom row: 921A, 921B, 921B, 921, CP3A-M, CP35, 961, CM1A. Every connection is a patch cord.

modules.name: 914 Fixed Filter Bank
modules.description: Fourteen parallel fixed filters: a low-pass, twelve high-Q band-pass filters from 125 Hz to 5.6 kHz, and a high-pass, each with a level knob.

modules.name: 923 Filters (and noise)
modules.description: A 6 dB/oct low-pass and a 6 dB/oct high-pass filter (10 Hz-10 kHz each), usable in series as a band-pass, plus white and pink noise.

modules.name: 904B Voltage Controlled High Pass Filter
modules.description: 24 dB/oct high-pass filter. FIXED CONTROL VOLTAGE sets the cutoff within the FREQUENCY RANGE; three summed control inputs at 1 V/oct.

modules.name: 904A Voltage Controlled Low Pass Filter
modules.description: 24 dB/oct low-pass ladder with REGENERATION (resonance to self-oscillation). FIXED CONTROL VOLTAGE sets the cutoff within the FREQUENCY RANGE; three summed control inputs at 1 V/oct.

modules.name: 902 Voltage Controlled Amplifier (1)
modules.description: VCA with linear or exponential response and a fixed control voltage. Two signal inputs and two outputs, labelled positive and negative.

properties.polarity_note: Behringer labels the inputs and outputs + and - (Zoe Blade); the quick start guide only says 'dual'

modules.name: 902 Voltage Controlled Amplifier (2)
modules.description: VCA with linear or exponential response and a fixed control voltage. Two signal inputs and two outputs, labelled positive and negative.

properties.polarity_note: Behringer labels the inputs and outputs + and - (Zoe Blade); the quick start guide only says 'dual'

modules.name: 911 Envelope Generator (1)
modules.description: Three-time-constant envelope: T1 attack, T2 initial decay, T3 final decay after release, with sustain level E SUS. Fired and held by an S-trigger (active low).

modules.name: 911 Envelope Generator (2)
modules.description: Three-time-constant envelope: T1 attack, T2 initial decay, T3 final decay after release, with sustain level E SUS. Fired and held by an S-trigger (active low).

modules.name: 921A Oscillator Driver (1)
modules.description: Master controller for up to twelve 921Bs. FREQUENCY (±6 octaves or ±12 semitones, by the rocker) and WIDTH (10-90%) are summed with two CV inputs each and sent as high-current frequency and width link outputs.

modules.name: 921B Oscillator (1)
modules.description: VCO driven from a 921A over the frequency and width link jacks. RANGE sets the octave (LO for sub-audio), FREQUENCY offsets it in semitones. Sine, triangle, sawtooth and rectangular outputs; hard sync from SYNC IN; AC and DC frequency modulation inputs.

modules.name: 921B Oscillator (2)
modules.description: VCO driven from a 921A over the frequency and width link jacks. RANGE sets the octave (LO for sub-audio), FREQUENCY offsets it in semitones. Sine, triangle, sawtooth and rectangular outputs; hard sync from SYNC IN; AC and DC frequency modulation inputs.

modules.name: 921 Voltage Controlled Oscillator
modules.description: Stand-alone VCO that doubles as an LFO (COARSE RNG sub-audio, typically 0.01-800 Hz; audio 1 Hz-80 kHz). Rectangular width with CV, a clamping point that resets the waveform from a V- or S-trigger, and an AUX output whose waveform and level are selectable.

modules.name: CP3A-M Mixer (1)
modules.description: Four-channel mixer with a master gain and positive and negative outputs, plus two passive four-jack multiples. Handles audio and CV.

modules.name: CP35 Attenuators / Voltage Source / Multiple
modules.description: Four passive attenuators with half-normalled inputs (input 1 feeds all four until later inputs are patched), +6 V and -6 V references, and two four-jack multiples.

modules.name: 961 Interface
modules.description: Trigger converter: audio to V-trigger (with SENSITIVITY), two S-to-V converters, and two V-to-S converters, each taking six direct (A) and six timed (B, SWITCH-ON TIME 40 ms-4 s) V-trigger inputs.

modules.name: CM1A MIDI to CV Converter
modules.description: MIDI and USB to CV and trigger. CV range switchable for System 15/35/55 (-5.3 to +4.7 V) or System 100/2500; mono or duophonic. TRIG MODE gives V-trig, S-trig, or one of each.

behaviours.name: 921B Oscillator
behaviours.rule: Pitch is the 921A link voltage plus RANGE and FREQUENCY, at 1 V/oct; pulse width follows the width link (0 to +6 V; outside that the rectangular output stops). Linked 921Bs track together and can be detuned with their own FREQUENCY knobs. LO turns a 921B into a sweep source.

behaviours.name: 921A Oscillator Driver
behaviours.rule: One 921A sets the pitch and pulse width of every 921B daisy-chained from it; with SEMITONE/OCTAVE at octave the FREQUENCY knob moves all of them by octaves.

behaviours.name: 921 Voltage Controlled Oscillator
behaviours.rule: Set COARSE RNG to sub for LFO duty ('Sub' in the patches). The clamping point resets the waveform on a trigger, for sync-like or key-synced LFOs. AUX gives any waveform, inverted if wanted, at a set level.

behaviours.name: 904A Voltage Controlled Low Pass Filter
behaviours.rule: Cutoff = FIXED CONTROL VOLTAGE plus the three control inputs, 1 V per octave within the selected range. REGENERATION at 9-10 makes it self-oscillate, as in Space Rock.

behaviours.name: 904B Voltage Controlled High Pass Filter
behaviours.rule: Cutoff = FIXED CONTROL VOLTAGE plus the three control inputs, 1 V per octave, within LOW or HIGH range.

behaviours.name: 902 Voltage Controlled Amplifier
behaviours.rule: Gain = FIXED CONTROL VOLTAGE plus the control inputs, linear or exponential. Equally happy with audio or CV, so a 902 fed with an LFO and an envelope makes delayed vibrato.

behaviours.name: 911 Envelope Generator
behaviours.rule: S-trigger held low starts T1, then T2 to E SUS while held; release starts T3. Times 2 ms to 10 s.

behaviours.name: 914 Fixed Filter Bank
behaviours.rule: All fourteen filters run in parallel; their levels shape a fixed formant, independent of pitch.

behaviours.name: 923 Filters (and noise)
behaviours.rule: Low-pass then high-pass in series gives a band-pass; both are gentle 6 dB/oct.

behaviours.name: CP3A-M Mixer
behaviours.rule: Four inputs summed through MASTER to + and - outputs. The multiples are passive and separate from the mixer.

behaviours.name: CP35 Attenuators / Voltage Source / Multiple
behaviours.rule: Attenuator inputs are half-normalled: input 1 feeds all four outputs until a lower input is patched, which takes over from there down. The multiples are passive buses.

behaviours.name: 961 Interface
behaviours.rule: Converts between Moog S-triggers (switch to ground) and V-triggers (+5 V), and from audio to V-triggers. Not needed with the CM1A in S-trig mode.

behaviours.name: CM1A MIDI to CV Converter
behaviours.rule: Select S-trig for the 911s. In System 55 range the pitch CV runs -5.3 to +4.7 V. MIDI channel, bend range and note range are set in SynthTribe.

behaviours.name: Triggers
behaviours.rule: The system uses Moog S-triggers (switch to ground, held for the note) for the 911 envelopes and 911A. The CM1A can output S-triggers directly; the 961 converts V-triggers (from the 960 or other gear) to S-triggers and back.

behaviours.name: Pitch
behaviours.rule: 1 V/oct throughout. A 921A drives any number of 921Bs through daisy-chained link jacks; set the CM1A to System 15/35/55 CV range.

behaviours.name: Warm-up and drift
behaviours.rule: Allow 30 minutes or more before playing. The oscillators are not temperature compensated, so offset and scaling drift until warm (Zoe Blade).

example_patches.name: Expressive Lead #1
example_patches.description: Two 921Bs through the CP3A-M and 904A to a 902 under the first 911. A delayed vibrato fades in on held notes: the 921 LFO runs through the second 902, opened by the second 911 (long attack, full sustain), into both 921Bs' DC MOD inputs. Legato playing keeps it out. Note: The guide lists 'three of four' 921B waveforms, copied from the System 35 text; with two 921Bs one waveform each (sawtooth) is assumed.

example_patches.name: Expressive Lead #2
example_patches.description: Pulse width modulation of two 921Bs (one slightly detuned) from a 921 sine, through the 904A with the second 911 on cutoff and the first 911 on the 902.

example_patches.name: Space Rock
example_patches.description: Two classic space rock sounds mixed: a self-oscillating 904A swept by a slow 921 sine and the first 921B (LO), and pink noise through the 904B swept by the second 921B for wind. Both benefit from lots of echo.

example_patches.name: Percussive Lead
example_patches.description: Two 921Bs (triangle and sawtooth, one slightly detuned) into the 904A and a 902; a hard envelope front and filter movement from a slow 921 sine and a second 911. Suits melodic sequencing. Note: The guide gives E SUS in seconds ('4 seconds') for the first 911 and as 9 for the second; E SUS is a level.

midi.note: Via the CM1A module only; channel set in SynthTribe. MIDI THRU on the CM1A.

source_inconsistencies: The Expressive Lead #1 audio list says 'three of four' 921B waveforms, but the System 15 has two 921Bs; the line is copied from the System 35 guide.
The 911's E SUS is a sustain level (0 to +5.5 V), but its guide calls it a sustain time and the system guides give it in seconds.
The system guides say the 921 should be in 'Sub' mode; the 921's switch is labelled COARSE RNG with sub-audio and audio positions.

modelling_gaps.detail: Each module is modelled as one block whose jacks expose its nodes; internal circuits are described, not wired.
Passive multiples are modelled as one input jack and three output jacks on a shared bus; the CP35's half-normalled inputs are a behaviour.
